sn:script.sn:pointer: A mysterious force surrounds the area. You may use a Tent or Cottage,and save your game.[end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: It's over...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: What a tragedy... He had such fantastic powers, but he was consumed by evil...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Yahoo!![end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: We didn't make it...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: SHIT!!! NO, NO, NO, NO, NO, NO!![end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: Can't...can't we do anything?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: What's that!?[end]
[bold]Cid[normal]: As long as I'm here, you've got nothing to worry about! Pedal to the metal, boys!![end]
[bold]Edward[normal]: Cecil! I'll show you the courage that you taught me![end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: And here I am all pumped up to fight that bastard! Ah, well... can't be breaking a sweat in front of the ladies.[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: Cecil...[end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: Fire at will, Dwarf Tank Force! The underground will also fight for Mother Earth![end]
[bold]Yang[normal]: I cannot rest as long as the world is in danger![end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Oh, I see! An inside job![end]

[bold]Palom[normal]: Well, that's basically the deal.[new] [bold]Porom[normal]: I'm sorry we deceived you. But we had no choice.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I understand. Considering my past, that was to be expected.[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: But you've purged the darkness from your soul... and received the holy light!? It can't be..![new] That sword?![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: The Light on the mountain gave it to me...[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Ages of prophecy, prayer, faith... and now...! Look! Engraved on the blade![new] It is...!! Mysidia's Legend![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Legend?[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Like I trust you! What if you become evil again?[end]
[bold]Caïn[normal]: ...If that happens, don't hold back... Kill me![end]
[bold]Caïn[normal]: ....I'm going too. I have a score I have to settle with this Zemus![end]
[bold]Caïn[normal]: Rosa...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: It's not Caïn's fault! Golbez...was under Zemus's control...[new] [bold]Caïn[normal]: Golbez?! What?![end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Damn straight! It's your own damned fault that the Giant showed up in the first place![end]
[bold]Caïn[normal]: Save the talk for later! We'll die if we don't hurry![end]

[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: This is the Giant's Heart, the control system![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Damn, it's HUGE![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Before we attack the Control System we've got to destroy the Defense System, or else it'll repair itself![end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: You've stopped the Giant! You will all PAY for this with your lives![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You!![end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: Who...!? Who the hell are you!?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You! Don't you even know who you are!?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: No, stop!![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Open your eyes![end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: ...No...what have I done?...Oh, God...what have I done? ...I was filled with so much hatred...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: ....You've regained your senses. ...Your father...Tell me your father's name![new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: My father.... KluYa...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: WHAT!?[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: All this time... Cecil's...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Brother!?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Golbez's my...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You were controlled by Zemus... Those of Lunar blood are susceptible to psychic power, thus easier to control...[new] You were his unwitting pawn...[end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: What the hell?![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I was... fighting my own brother... ...[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: You're my....[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: But it could have been the other way around... I could have been used for evil... I was a Dark Knight...[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: ...But our souls were tested... You renounced evil, so I was found wanting... Zemus!!![end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: Where are you going!?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: I'm going to end this myself![end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Zemus is also of our race! I'll come with you...!![end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: Cecil! Come on! He'll get himself killed![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: He's walking straight to his death![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: He's your brother, right?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...Brother...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: Go after him![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ....[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Holy shit! This is not good![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: We've got to get out of here![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: .....[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: What the hell are you doing!?[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: How do we get out of here!? 'This way!'[end]
[bold]Rosa[normal]: Caïn![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: We won't fall for that![end]
[bold]Caïn[normal]: I finally regained control of myself. My mind was held captive by my evil actions...[new] I can't ask you to forgive me, but...[end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: Golbez is Cecil's brother...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ....[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Golbez and Cecil have blood of the Lunarians, an advanced race hibernating on the moon.[new] One Lunarian, Zemus, wanted to enslave the earth, so he used Golbez to gather the Crystals.[new] However, another Lunarian named FuSoYa removed the spell on Golbez...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: And then Golbez went to the moon with FuSoYa to defeat Zemus.[new] [bold]Caïn[normal]: Golbez's.... Cecil's brother..?[end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: Oh, believe me, I will. Between you and Zemus, at least I'm guaranteed some action![new] Besides, I'm not just going to sit back and let Zemus play with the lives of people like that![new] [bold]Caïn[normal]: Edge...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Let's go...[end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: Now Rydia, this is where you get off. Leave the bad guys to us.[new] You just stay here and be a good little girl![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: ...You'd better be kidding, because I'd hate to be you if you weren't. Let me tell you what I'd do to some pig who talked to me like that.[new] I'd end his reproductive years rather quickly.[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Rydia... That was kinda below the belt. I don't blame you for being a bitch to me...[new] God, I'll miss you.[end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: ....[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Get out of my way...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: No! Unless you take me with you, I'm not moving an inch.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: What!! Rosa! It's dangerous out there![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: As long as I'm near you, whatever happens... [music][0x13] ...no, as long as I'm with you I don't care how dangerous things are![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Rosa...[new] [bold]Caïn[normal]: ...Come on, Cecil...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Yeah, let her come! At least you've got a woman. I have two chances with Rydia, slim and none...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: All right, Rosa... I'll... I'll protect you![end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: Rydia!! You're here![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: As I said before, this is everybody's fight, not just yours. Plus I'm the only Summoner you have![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Rydia... All right... Let's go! We'll fight...for everyone![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Rosa and Rydia, you stay here. The three of us will go by ourselves.[new] This time there's no guarantee that we'll come back alive...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: Are you joking!?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Come on, get off the Magical Ship![end]
'I am...pure darkness... Augmented by Zemus' hatred...'[end]

[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: To think that you all had that much power! The Blue Planet has evolved so much while we've been asleep![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Ha! To hear Rydia talk, I should be the missing link![end]

[bold]Village Elder[normal]: You! You're that Dark Knight! What have you come to destroy this time?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: My name is Cecil, and I was the head of Baron's airship force.[new] I came here before as a coward...I couldn't bring myself to disobey the King's orders. Now I come seeking forgiveness.[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Even if you apologize, it won't bring back the people you murdered.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ....[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: However... I sense a faint glimmer of light within you that was not there before.[new] It might be worth listening to what you have to say.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I'm fighting Golbez, the man who is controlling Baron.[new] When my friends and I tried to prevent the theft of the Wind Crystal, he kidnapped one of us.[new] We were going to save her, but Leviathan attacked us, and now...[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: ...You lost your friends... It seems Fate has chosen you to endure this trial. And Fate brought you back here.[new] You seek to destroy a great darkness, but as long as you rely on the Dark Sword, you cannot defeat true evil.[new] Your soul is stained with the darkness of your deeds... Evil is like a cancer. It spreads, consuming the soul entirely.[new] You could become as evil as the man you seek. If you wish for your faint glimmer to become a radiant light, then go to Mt.[new] Ordeals in the east.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: But I must save my friend![new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: If you truly cherish this friend, you will endure this trial, and be bathed in the purifying light of redemption at the summit.[new] You must renounce your Dark Sword and receive the power of a Holy Knight... a Paladin! Be warned, though.[new] Many have sought to become a Paladin.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: They tried and failed?[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Oh, no. They tried and died... But you seem to carry a great destiny... What do you say, will you go?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...Yes![new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: But your Dark Sword will have little effect on the monsters of the mountain. I'll send Magicians with you.[new] Palom! Porom![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Who are you...?[new] [bold]Old Man[normal]: I am FuSoYa, guardian of the sleeping People of the Moon, the Lunarians.[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Lunarians?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Correct. It's been a very long time...[new] We are people from a long- destroyed planet that was between the fourth and fifth planet of the solar system.[new] During the final days of our world, we built a ship and traveled to the Blue Planet... The journey was long...[new] We had to hibernate for survival.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: The Blue Planet...?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: The planet that you live on. But the creatures of your planet were still evolving, so we created another moon and continued sleeping...[end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: Another moon?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: But one of us refused to sleep... He wanted to purge your planet of all living beings so we could settle there.[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: How awful...![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: ....He was a brilliant man, but impatient. We tried to reason with him, but he wouldn't listen.[new] Instead, he became bitter and vengeful... He created the Tower of Babil to give mankind the tool to destroy themselves.[new] It was then I forced that man to sleep, but his mind was still awake.[new] Over these eons, he became consumed with hatred, increasing his psychic powers to destroy every living thing...[new] Since he is sealed below, he uses his powers to control those with a dark soul...[end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Then Golbez is merely a puppet?![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Who is this guy!?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: His name is Zemus...! The Crystals are our source of energy.[new] Zemus, knowing this, used the Crystals' power to operate the Dimensional Elevator in the Tower of Babil.[new] Once all the crystals are gathered, the elevator brings down mankind's doom... the Giant of Babil![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: The 'way to the Moon'...is that...?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: But the rest of us aren't like that...[new] We wanted to wait until the people of the Blue Planet were advanced enough to be able to speak with us, to share our hopes, fears, experiences, and fates...[new] Together, our combined people could have done so much... We...dreamed of that day...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: What about the Magical Ship that brought us here?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: It wasn't too long ago that my younger brother, KluYa, made it and went to the Blue Planet.[new] KluYa was enthralled with your world and often spoke about aiding your evolution... He built the Devil Road, and gave your people the technology to build airships.[new] He founded Mysidia and taught them legends that would make our dream a reality.[new] However, KluYa fell in love with a woman from the Blue Planet. She bore him two children. One of them was... ...you, Cecil.[end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: !! Me...? Then the voice I heard on Mt. Ordeals was...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Your father... It was KluYa's spirit... I see now...you look so much like KluYa... when he was young...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: That voice was... my father...![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: KluYa gave you his power to combat Zemus... We must stop him![new] For the people of the Moon and of the Blue Planet! Hurry to the Tower of Babil![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: The Tower of Babil!? But it's surrounded by a barrier![end]

[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: I have powers that can neutralize the barrier! We cannot let the Giant of Babil be unleashed upon the Blue Planet![new] I shall go with you! [space][0x8]Lunarian FuSoYa [space][0x7]joined the party![music][0x29][delay][0x28][end]
[bold]Caïn[normal]: But about those final words that Zeromus left...[end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: As long as evil hearts still exist...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Everyone holds both good and evil in his soul... just like there are Crystals of Light and Darkness...[new] Evil will never disappear... but as long as humans continue to band together... cherishing the ideals of virtue, trust, and honor, it will never triumph.[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Preach on, brother! I make it my personal responsibility to be a bastion of virtue![end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: 'Bastion of virtue!' What the hell are you talking about!? It's almost a miracle that someone like you didn't get possessed by Zemus![end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: This pretty face, evil? That'd be a crying shame![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: At least the Blue Planet will be lively with you two around... Now, I must return to my sleep. What will you do?[end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: We're going to return to our world.[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Everyone's waiting for us![end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: I see. You have wonderful friends. I will look forward to meeting with your people again.[end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: May I... May I go with you?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: Yes... I...can't go back. Not after what I've done.[new] And I'd also like to meet my father's people.[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: I see...You also have Lunarian blood flowing in your veins... But it will be a long sleep.[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: I know.[end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: Brother...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ....[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: ....I see...I'm not worthy to be called your brother.... I've caused you... so much pain...Back then...[new] I was arrogant... merciless...unforgiving... Now I stand before you a broken...defeated... repentant man.[new] Maybe...I can comfort the aching of my soul in sleep...[end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: We must go now... I pray for peace on the Blue Planet.[end]
[bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil...[new] [bold]Caïn[normal]: Cecil, forgive him as you did me...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: He's your brother![end]

[bold]Village Elder[normal]: All right! The topic of today's lesson is 'Transfiguration and Teleportation.'[delay][0x20] Have you been practicing your Teleport spell?[new] [bold]Porom[normal]: Yes, sir. [delay][0x1c][new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: What about your Dejon spell, Palom...? Palom?[new] [bold]Porom[normal]: Not again!![delay][0x1c][close_window][end]

[bold]Palom[normal]: And then, I single- handedly killed the teeming hordes of undead on Mt. Ordeals.[new] As you can imagine,[delay][0x20] I was tired, but no rest for the weary...[new] Cecil needed me to cast my powerful Blizzard spell...[delay][0x20] He said I was far more heroic than him...[new] Ah, I can see by the blank stare in your eyes, you think so too...[delay][0x1d] Whaddya say we find a quieter place where I can show you something, ahem... equally impressive...?[delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Palom[normal]: Ow-ow-ow![new] [bold]Porom[normal]: You perverted little boy![new] [bold]Palom[normal]: I was just going to[delay][0x18] show her my...uh...Fire Rod![new] [bold]Porom[normal]: Yeah, I bet... Our Elder's really mad at you! Come on![delay][0x1d][close_window][end]

[bold]Village Elder[normal]: How many times do I have to tell you not to skip lessons? What do I have to do to get through to a[delay][0x20] precocious know-it-all?[new] Maybe scribing spells will help you see the importance of lessons![delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Chamberlain[normal]: ...And furthermore, you lack the discipline to be an effective ruler...[delay][0x19][close_window][end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Enough already! I ask you for a few suggestions on self-improvement...[delay][0x19] and you rattle off a full-blown dissertation![delay][0x10][close_window][end]

[bold]Chamberlain[normal]: I haven't even started. Next, your female companions leave something to be desired...[delay][0x20][new] [bold]Edge[normal]: What's wrong with women? I happen to like women! [delay][0x18][new] [bold]Chamberlain[normal]: That's not what I meant.[new] You 'accidentally' bump into every pretty girl you see, and go into[delay][0x20] convulsions when one bends over to pick something up.[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Okay, okay! I'll settle down![delay][0x1d][new] [bold]Chamberlain[normal]: Please do so, for a change![delay][0x10][close_window][end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: But, Rydia... Beauty, intelligence, and a sharp tongue... [delay][0x18] Now there's a woman who could settle me down![new] Damn, I need her...[delay][0x18][close_window][end]
[bold]Leviathan[normal]: She's an incredible girl![new] [bold]Ashura[normal]: I never thought she'd come this far...[delay][0x1a][close_window][end]
[bold]Monster Child[normal]: Hey, Rydia. How come I've got fangs and you don't? I wish I was like you.[delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Rydia[normal]: What are you talking about? Humans and Phantom Beasts both have the ability[delay][0x20] to love and care about others.[new] So you see, we're really not that different.[delay][0x1c][close_window][end]

[bold]Ashura[normal]: Our world will be interesting from now on, don't you think?[new] [bold]Leviathan[normal]: Yes![delay][0x19] She's even got an ancient being like me excited about the future! What a lovely young woman![delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: Inner beauty is the most important, though... [delay][0x18][close_window][end]

'Sing us another song about the Paladin!' [delay][0x10] [bold]Edward[normal]: Not until you're finished with today's work.[new] Don't you want to rebuild our castle?[delay][0x1e] 'Aw, man...But there're no more monsters!' [delay][0x12][new] [bold]Edward[normal]: That's what the Paladin did for us.[new] He got rid of those scary monsters. [delay][0x18] But there are some things worse than monsters.[new] We don't want our mommies and daddies getting sick and dying.[delay][0x20] That's why we've got to rebuild our castle.[new] And we need everybody helping, even you little children.[delay][0x20] Tell you what... After you're done with your work, I'll sing an extra-special song for you![delay][0x1a][close_window][end]

[bold]Edward[normal]: Watch me from heaven, Anna.[new] I still have the people of Damcyan to care for...[delay][0x19] I can only pray that you and your father will smile upon us...[delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Yang[normal]: You're a Queen now! Stop calling me 'Dear'!! It is not fitting for a woman of your stature.[delay][0x1d] Yang'[new] [bold]s wife[normal]: I hate all that formal stuff though! This royalty bit is new to me.[delay][0x18][new] [bold]Yang[normal]: You make a fine Queen! Oh! It's time for training![delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Former King[normal]: I know what you're thinking.[new] You're concerned about the pomp and regalia of nobility.[delay][0x20] Heed these words of experience.[new] Royalty is nothing more than the gift of leadership and love for[delay][0x20] one's countrymen...[new] I have the utmost confidence that you will return Fabul to her past glory![delay][0x1e][close_window][end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: All right! Let's get working and fix up this castle![delay][0x18][close_window][end]
'Your Majesty! We don't have enough raw materials to do that, Lali!'[delay][0x19][close_window][end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: The Tanks! Scrap the Tanks! We don't need 'em! There won't be any more wars![delay][0x19][close_window][end]
[bold]Luka[normal]: Father! Have you heard from Cecil or any of the others?[delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Jiott[normal]: Thanks for reminding me![new] A courier from Baron arrived with these greetings...[delay][0x20] Sir Cecil is ascending the throne, and taking Rosa to be his Queen![new] [bold]Luka[normal]: Wow![delay][0x1d][new] [bold]Jiott[normal]: We've been invited to their coronation![new] [bold]Luka[normal]: All right![delay][0x18][close_window][end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: Dammit, I already told you to destroy the tanks![delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Caïn[normal]: Cecil... Rosa... Forgive me...once more...[new] I cannot attend... [delay][0x1c] My actions have shamed the ranks of Dragon Knights everywhere... Mt.[new] Ordeals tested you, Cecil...[delay][0x20] Now I must test myself... If I surpass my father as a Dragon Knight, his spirit might forgive me...[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Rosa[normal]: What's wrong, Cecil? [delay][0x20][new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Nothing... I thought...I heard my brother's voice...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Oh...[delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Cid[normal]: What the... Are the two of you STILL here!? [delay][0x20] It's a beautiful day, and everyone's coming! So hurry up![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Sorry about that.[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Cid[normal]: Jeez! You'll be able to mess around until you're sick of it later![new] Come on now, Rosa![delay][0x20] ...No, no, I mean, your Majesty![delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Cid[normal]: Really!? Well then, Rosa! The maids are all ready! [delay][0x20] It's you that's holding up the show.[new] So come on! Hurry up already![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: I'm coming![delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: It's been so long since we've last seen everyone. [delay][0x20] They should be coming about now! Cecil, hurry along![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I will, Rosa.[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: I did hear it... I'm sure of it... My brother's voice... [delay][0x20] He said...'Good-bye'...[delay][0x18][close_window][end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: Zemus... No, Zeromus! You will meet your end by my hands![end]
[bold]Zeromus[normal]: ...Suffer! Perish! Until everything is destroyed... My hatred will continue...[new] Now you...Come... ...into my eternal darkness...[end]
[bold]Village Elder[normal]: Now the time has come for us to pray for them... ....no, we must pray for the earth![end]
[bold]Village Elder[normal]: Palom, Porom! We must send our prayers to Cecil![end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: The earth! Fight for the earth![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: These two!?[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Correct. These two are the twin magicians, Palom and Porom.[new] They're young and still in training, but they possess power far beyond their years...[new] [bold]Palom[normal]: Damn straight! I'm gonna help you so you better be grateful![new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Palom! What have I told you about arrogance?[end]
[bold]King Baron[normal]: Go to the land of the Phantom Beasts... and return here...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Your Majesty![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Your Majesty...[new] [bold]King Baron[normal]: The look in you eyes is one of sadness, Cecil... Yes, it is truly me...[new] I was murdered, but I became the soul of a Phantom Beast... The Summoner from Mist may call my name, but you must be tested...[end]

[bold]King Baron[normal]: You have become strong... Fight for Baron... no, fight for the world! I will fight alongside you as Odin![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Your Majesty! [space][0x5]Rydia learned Odin![music][0x29][delay][0x28][end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: But that light... It called me... ...My son...[end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: No, it's nothing... Let's go to bed...[end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Is everyone okay?[new] [bold]Cid[normal]: Yeah... But the Enterprise is shot. Trying to fly it would be dangerous.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Well, what can we do? Let's get off.[end]
[bold]Porom[normal]: Please pardon his impudence.[new] [bold]Palom[normal]: I can see why you're Cecil's friend. Both of you were Baron's puppets.[end]
